oliver: Main is red after merge — failing job unit-tests-linux-gpu. CI link: https://ci.redwood.ai/pipelines/2345/builds/6789 commit abc1234. ping @alex @maria to triage
ci-bot: Build 6789 failed • unit-tests-linux-gpu • tests/inference/test_kv_cache.py::test_eviction • exit code 2

jamal: flipping alert for infra channel. @alex can you bisect? please hold deploys if this is a regression
alex: on it. starting git bisect now. if someone can rerun just the failing job that would help speed things up
maria: fyi PR #452 touched kv cache eviction + batching, could be related
kim: if bisect points to that commit we should revert asap and cut a patch — i can open a revert PR
alex: bisect plan:
```
# from a checked-out main
git bisect start HEAD abc1234
# mark bad/good until narrowed
```
will report back in ~10m

alex: bisect done — culprit commit = def5678 (merged via PR #452). changes to KV LRU edge-case introduced the break
jamal: putting a hold on deploys to prod/dedicated pools :raised_hands:
kim: opened revert PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/revert-pr-452 — please review & merge if green
maria: i'll review the revert and also start a test + fix to handle the eviction edge-case so this doesn't flake
oliver: thanks all — keep updates here. we'll include details in the postmortem
